summary: Iteration 3 (activation flow + pool countdowns) tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass (health, config, SIWE auth, user, dashboard stats incl. new min_activation_usdt + resets, and new POST /api/activate happy path, min guard, unknown address, exact-min, no-upper-cap, repeat activation, checksummed address, 422 validation). Frontend (390px mobile): demo-wallet SIWE connect -> Activate card appears at top with Inactive badge; amount 5 shows 'Minimum activation is $10 USDT' toast and does NOT activate; quick-100 + activate flips badge to Active, hides Activate card, and refreshes stats (activated users 5->6, creator $212,531->$212,551 = +20 of 100, daily pool +15); all three pool countdowns render and tick each second, Community Fund has none; bottom nav Stake/Pools/Mining/My Team show Coming Soon and Dashboard tab returns; Active status + session persist after reload; WalletConnect button correctly disabled.

minor.issue: No idempotency/state guard: an already-Active user can call activate repeatedly, each call re-incrementing creator/pool/community balances and total_deposited. If re-deposit is intended this is fine; otherwise add an is_active check or a separate deposit endpoint.

amount has no Pydantic constraint (e.g. gt=0); negative values are handled only by the min-check message ('Minimum activation is $10 USDT'), which is a misleading error for -100. Consider Field(gt=0) + explicit message.

Seeded mock ledger is mutated permanently by activations (creator balance now ~$212.5k vs seed $12.5k after test deposits). No reset endpoint; any test asserting exact seed values will fail. Tests were made delta-based.

issues: Stale copy: Stake still says 'Coming soon in Module 2' although Module 2 (activation) is now shipped; body text still says 'Module 1 delivers the foundation'. Update module mapping/copy.
Countdown text is 11px text-white/45 on #0A0D1C — borderline low contrast for a live/important value; consider text-white/60.
When a target time elapses, Countdown falls back to '--:--:--' and never refetches new reset timestamps/pool values until reload; consider re-calling stats when the timer hits zero.

action_items: Decide/implement activation idempotency for already-Active users on POST /api/activate
Add Pydantic amount validation (gt=0) with a distinct error for non-positive amounts
Update ComingSoon module labels/copy (Stake no longer 'Module 2', drop 'Module 1 delivers the foundation')
Optional: auto-refresh dashboard stats/resets when a countdown reaches zero; slightly raise countdown text contrast
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /activate mixes deposit accounting with activation; splits total only 80% (20+15*4) with no record of the remaining 20% — verify the tokenomics split is intentional and document/persist per-deposit ledger entries for auditability.
No per-address deposit history is stored (only total_deposited), which will make the later on-chain reconciliation and My Team/rewards modules hard; consider a deposits collection.
_pool_resets() is computed per request; fine, but frontend keeps a stale target after midnight (see design issue).
seed_data_creation: Several throwaway SIWE demo wallets/users created by backend tests and one browser demo wallet (TTN100026, activated with $100). protocol_stats balances increased accordingly.
test_credentials: Wallet-based only; connect-demo-btn creates a fresh random wallet each time (always Inactive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now uses delta/>= assertions for protocol_stats because activation permanently mutates the seeded ledger; do not reintroduce exact seed-value assertions. Activation tests are in TestActivation; helper authed_wallet(client) creates a SIWE-verified user. Frontend: after connecting via connect-demo-btn the user is always Inactive so activate-card is present.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking defect found this iteration; the only functional gaps are the missing already-active guard and non-positive amount validation on POST /api/activate.
